assertion_audit.106: Fails if a second poll repeats the already-announced slow tick.
assertion_audit.114: Fails if tick completion is not published/consumed and producer-restored is absent, or if duplicate events are returned.
assertion_audit.115: Fails if a recovery advertises a remedy.
assertion_audit.116: Fails if the completed tick remains classified slow instead of live.
assertion_audit.132: Fails if a stopped station answer disappears instead of remaining observable.
assertion_audit.134: Fails if a frozen heartbeat is considered live or slow rather than stopped, for either storage branch.
assertion_audit.136: Fails if a stopped station does not yield exactly producer-lost.
assertion_audit.137,184: Fail if the lost row drops or changes the existing ensure command; these intentionally reuse the production command composer and do not independently validate its syntax, which this node does not change.
assertion_audit.138: Fails if the prescribed remedy is absent from the human-readable lost line.
assertion_audit.148,150: Fail if a health record belonging to a different exporting host revives the stale export.
assertion_audit.160: Fails unless the instrument sees the valid live publication before each damaged-record case; prevents a uniformly stale reader from passing the negative cases.
assertion_audit.180: Fails if malformed JSON, a non-object, mismatched host/job, invalid markers, unreadable beat, or an older beat is trusted as current health.
assertion_audit.181: Fails if rejecting a damaged record loses the export heartbeat instead of preserving its independently computed age.
assertion_audit.183: Fails if the damaged-record branch suppresses the genuine producer-lost row.
assertion_audit.49: Fails if the fixture export is not actually written; a setup check, not independent regression coverage.
assertion_audit.50,74: Fail if the follower can unexpectedly access the local store; prove the off-node branch is reached.
assertion_audit.51,80,133: Fail if the supposed off-node answer uses local storage or the local control uses export storage.
assertion_audit.69: Fails if heartbeat does not persist the advanced injected clock; a storage round-trip assertion, not the principal regression guard.
assertion_audit.73: Fails if the local control no longer classifies a fresh beat with an overlong running tick as slow.
assertion_audit.77,104: Fail with producer-lost when base modules are restored, or if publication or the exported-answer fallback is removed independently.
assertion_audit.78: Fails if the slow row advertises a remedy or re-arm despite the station being alive.
assertion_audit.81: Fails if the off-node reading retains the frozen exported heartbeat instead of the newer health publication.
assertion_audit.89: Each state, beat age, stage, tick age and tick-start comparison fails if local and exported readers disagree; both sides read distinct storage paths, and lines 73,90,91 separately pin expected outcomes.
assertion_audit.90: Fails if the published stage is dropped or substituted; it compares a read result to the stage originally persisted in the independent station store.
assertion_audit.91: Fails if tick age is reset or frozen; elapsed fixture time is three freshness windows plus three seconds, independent of returned age.
assertion_audit.92: Fails if local and exported obligation payloads diverge; this is a parity check, not proof that both payloads are correct.
assertion_audit.93: Fails if the beat rewrites the stored obligation computation timestamp.
assertion_audit.96: Fails if any heartbeat operation rewrites the original obligation export bytes.

assertion_independence: No regression guard is vacuous under restoration of the relevant defect; input-derived round-trip assertions and shared remedy-composer limits are explicitly identified in assertion_audit.
